prompts.handoff: Your ticket is work on Metaform's map, and it is taken for you. Read it with `metaform map work id=` and work it. Say how many steps you plan with `metaform map work op=plan id= steps=<n>`, report each step as you finish it with `metaform map work op=step id= said="<one sentence>"`, and when it is done close it with `metaform map work op=done id= resolution="<what you found or changed>"`.
prompts.nodes: The namespace nodes of this work, as the map holds them:
prompts.handed: Give this to the agent you hand the work to, to run: `metaform `
